mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, potentially increasing ciprofloxacin levels; ciprofloxacin may inhibit disulfiram metabolism via CYP450 enzymes, increasing disulfiram toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for ciprofloxacin and disulfiram toxicity signs; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; assess QT prolongation risk and CNS adverse effects during concurrent use.
